title: Port one production plugin to v2.0 as canonical example
description: Forcing function for API completeness. Land port in examples/ or its own repo. The v1.x version stays in production on master/1.x. See migration-04 section B6.1.

title: Unit test coverage for Definition layer + Dispatcher
description: Tests for every public method on Definition classes. End-to-end fixture app test. Target 80%+ coverage on Definition + Dispatcher. See migration-04 section B5.1.

title: Extract Hook/Dispatcher: move invoke() out of Filter
description: New Hook/Dispatcher consumes compiled definition graph. Registers WP hooks, handles invocation. Decorators become metadata only. See migration-04 section B3.2.

title: Remove with_*() mutators from decorators; make immutable
description: Strip fluent mutators from Hook/Handler/Filter/Action/Module/etc. Constructor takes all data. Public attribute syntax unchanged for users. See migration-04 section B3.1.

title: Refactor Hook/Compiler to serialize primitive arrays
description: Cache file becomes plain arrays instead of var_export'd decorator objects. Stable across constructor changes. See migration-04 section B2.2.

title: Refactor Hook/Parser to emit Definition objects
description: Parser output type changes from raw arrays + decorator instances to typed Definition objects. See migration-04 section B2.1.

title: Introduce src/Definition/ with HookDefinition + ModuleDefinitionHelper
description: Port HookDefinition interface and ModuleDefinitionHelper from rewrite branch, adapt to beta layout. Add module() factory in xwp-di-definition-fns.php. See migration-04 section B1.1.

title: Lock public API surface for 2.0
description: Audit src/ and mark every non-public class @internal. Update docs/migration-03-public-api.md with corrections found during audit. Blocks every later slice. See migration-04 section B0.1.
close_reason: Public API surface audited and locked: non-public implementation classes/traits/helpers are tagged @internal, migration docs corrected, focused orphan audit reports no public API orphans, annotation-only tests removed per review.

title: Clear existing PHPStan and PHPCS baseline failures
description: Validation for di-bao.1 still reports pre-existing quality-gate failures outside the public API surface annotation slice: PHPStan reflector/template issues in Decorators/Dynamic_Filter.php, Decorators/Filter.php, Decorators/Handler.php, Decorators/Module.php; PHPCS class-structure ordering issues in Decorators/Action.php, Decorators/Dynamic_Action.php, Traits/Accessible_Hook_Methods.php, Decorators/CLI_Command.php, Decorators/CLI_Handler.php, Hook/Factory.php.
acceptance_criteria: vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=512M passes; vendor/bin/phpcs passes; no behavioral refactors beyond the minimum needed for these gates.

title: Bootstrap modern PHPUnit test harness with docker-compose MySQL
description: Project has no test harness today (no phpunit.xml, no scripts, no test files — only fixtures at test/fixtures/shared/). Adding wp-phpunit/yoast-polyfills based PHPUnit 9.6 setup with two suites (unit via Brain\Monkey, integration via wp-phpunit), a docker-compose.test.yml MySQL 8.0 service for local devs, a .github/workflows/tests.yml matrix (PHP 8.1-8.4) for CI. Closes the 'A test directory beyond fixtures' gap noted in docs/migration-02-current-state.md:35 and unblocks v2.0 migration work.
acceptance_criteria: composer test:up && composer test:install && composer test runs both suites green locally; .github/workflows/tests.yml runs the matrix green on push/PR; existing test/fixtures/ stays untouched and reused
close_reason: Bootstrapped PHPUnit harness: docker-compose MySQL 8 service, wp-phpunit + yoast/phpunit-polyfills + Brain\Monkey deps, phpunit.xml.dist with unit/integration suites, tests/bootstrap.php and wp-tests-config.php, tests/bin/install-tests.php (no SVN — downloads WP core via tarball), sample tests for both suites (5 unit + 2 integration, all green locally), .github/workflows/tests.yml matrix for PHP 8.1-8.4 with mysql:8.0 service, README ## Testing section. Existing test/fixtures/ left untouched.

title: Tag 2.0.0-beta.1, then 2.0.0 GA
description: Lock event. Soak window 2 weeks minimum. After GA, public surface frozen until 3.0. See migration-04 section B6.2.

title: Module imports/exports/providers via ModuleDefinitionHelper
description: Modules compose via definition graph, not just attribute arrays. Both styles coexist. See migration-04 section B4.1.

title: Add ServiceDefinition for autowired services and providers
description: Typed definition for module services[]. Supports autowire/factory/value providers. See migration-04 section B1.3.

title: Add definition validation: cycles, missing deps, schema
description: Compile-time validation pass. Detects import cycles, undeclared deps, conflicting service IDs. See migration-04 section B1.4.

title: Add HandlerDefinition and CallbackDefinition value objects
description: Immutable value objects covering metadata currently mutable on Decorators/Handler and Decorators/Filter. See migration-04 section B1.2.

title: Set CI matrix for PHP 8.1-8.4 and drop composer upper bound
description: composer.json PHP constraint becomes >=8.1 with no upper bound. CI matrix runs PHP 8.1, 8.2, 8.3, 8.4. See migration-04 section B0.2.

title: Write migration plan docs (00-05)
description: Flesh out docs/migration-00-context.md through migration-05-deprecation-and-shipping.md. Reference for all later work. See migration-04 section B0.3.

title: v2.0 GA: lock public API and ship clean DI library
description: Bring beta to production-ready 2.0 with a layered DI architecture (definition / compilation / dispatch). See docs/migration-00-context.md and docs/migration-04-implementation-plan.md.
